sources.snippet: get_mrope_input_positions(input_tokens,mm_features) ¶ MiniCPM-V uses embedding injection for vision, not spatial M-RoPE. All tokens (text and vision placeholders) get identical sequential positions duplicated across the 3 M-RoPE channels expected by the Qwen3.5 backbone.
